page.layout: Running head at top, page number at top left. Two engraved medallion portraits side by side at the top. Below them one column of text in two paragraphs, the second beginning after a gap.

main_text.l: PROPH. HIEREMIAS
PROPH. BARUCH
JEREMIAS Propheta,puer adhuc vaticinari incepit an-
no 13. regni Josiæ Regis Judæ,qui erat annus mundi 3307.ante
Christum natum 655. Hic in Juda tantum & Beniamin pro-
phetauit, iam enim decem tribus Israël Assyrij in Medos trans-
stulerant : civitatis Jerosolymæ ruinas quadruplici planxit al-
phabeto. Anathothites dictus est à viculo tribus ab Jerosoly-
mis milibus distante:hic sacerdos ex sacerdotibus,& in matris
utero sanctificatus est,& ad prophetiam segregatus,quam cum
detrectaret,causatus imperitiam,doctrinam, animum quoque
à Deo accepit. Tandem apud Taphnas in Ægypto,à populo la-
pidibus obrutus,occubuit. Vide D.Jero. in Jeremiam. Jeremiæ
vitam ac vincula qui cupit amplius nosse, legat eiusdem pro-
phetiam,item Ecclesiast.cap.49.& 2.Machab.2.& Jose.lib. An-
tiq 10.cap.8.& sequentibus.
BARUCH Propheta, & Jeremiæ scriba fuit, qui librum
Jeremiæ scripsit de futuris rebus civitati,populo & templo.fuit
quoque Jeremiæ in carcere minister, & in exilio socius, nec
eum unquam deseruit. Prophetauit Baruch in Babylonia tem-
pore captiuitatis Judæ, prophetiámque suam legit coram rege
Joachin, qui & Jechonias dictus est. multa ac magna mysteria
de incarnatione Domini ac de nouissimis temporibus prophe-
tauit. Vide lib.Baruch.Josephlib.[?]Antiq.10.cap.8.& catalogum
Sanctorum.

page.notes: Two engraved oval medallion portraits: the left one shows Jeremiah, a bearded old man, labelled PROPH. HIEREMIAS; the right one shows Baruch, a bearded man in profile, labelled PROPH. BARUCH. The text is not set in a margin and has no marginal notes. "Josephlib." is faint in the scan; the reading is doubtful.
